title: 10 Hard SAT Math Questions to Try Before November 7
description:
Taking the SAT on November 7? Try these 10 hard SAT-style math questions first. Pause before each answer, keep score, and use the breakdown at the end to see what to review.

Covered:
• Percent change traps and statistics
• Perpendicular lines and systems with infinitely many solutions
• The vertex of a parabola, radical equations (extraneous solutions), and tangent lines
• Right-triangle trig and circle equations
• Equivalent exponential forms (the hardest one)

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank.
